popCulture.title: Nostoi
popCulture.description: The Epic Cycle's Returns — Apollodorus' closing catalogue of captains who settled abroad still echoes the lost poem's diaspora after Troy.

popCulture.title: Epic Cycle
popCulture.description: The Trojan cycle that framed every nostos — from Agamemnon's murder to the lesser settlements of Guneus, Agapenor, and their peers.
